summary: Build the Basic House at once with the 6 starting Logs, then Lumberjacks' Base, Clay Pit and Farm. Plant around 40 Cabbage tiles (4-day growth, 1 Veggie each) so the stock reaches 25 even while six villagers eat; a second house settles everyone for the optional objective.

build_order.note: First objective; the 6 starting Logs pay for it exactly.
6 Sticks from fallen sticks. Logs for the second house.
Plant about 40 tiles near the Farm: 4-day crop, so two harvests land well inside 25 days.
Second house: six villagers but four beds per house; settles everyone (optional).

pitfalls: No Sticks start in stock: everything waits on sticks dropped by the 47 trees, so start with the cheapest building that unlocks the next.
Villagers eat Veggies too (about two thirds of a food item per villager per day); keep the Foragers' Hut staffed so Fruit takes some of the load, and plant more tiles than 25.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
